steps.action: I cannot sign in: staff sign-in with a wrong password, then the correct one
steps.expected: A wrong password shows a visible error on the staff sign-in page, and the account still signs in with the right password (one failure, well under the ten-failure lockout).
steps.actual: The staff sign-in page offered ["Sign in","Set up or reset your password","Email me a sign-in link"]. A wrong password showed "Check your email and password." and stayed on the page. The correct password then signed in to /.

steps.action: I cannot sign in: a Portal link already used; request a new link and open the newest message
steps.expected: Reusing a spent link shows a link-specific expired or already-used message; a new link from the newest message signs in; the Portal session does not open staff pages.
steps.actual: The first link (subject "Sign in to OpenLaw") signed in once and landed on /portal. Opening the same link in a new browser context landed on /auth/link-expired with heading "Sign-in link expired" and the text "The link has expired or was already used. Enter your email to get a fresh one.". A new link from the newest message signed in and landed on /portal. Going to /contracts in that session landed on /portal/onboarding. Screenshot docs/documentation/batches/DOC-032/bridge/walkthrough-troubleshooting/business-user-link-expired.png.
